I replied to Tobias in your DM. I confirmed his standing Thistle rollout call with the Marrow Fieldworks team is now Fridays at 8:30, and that I made no calendar changes. I also offered to set up a recurring event if he wants one.

I didn't save this to my persistent memory. That memory carries into every conversation, including other members' conversations, and DM content must stay private. The note lives in that DM thread instead, so I can find it there when he asks.
